svg.title: Coworking day pass: prioritize the visitor’s booking decision
svg.desc: Before: capacity and meeting-room counts lead. After: day-pass price, opening hours, desk and Wi-Fi inclusion lead. The same facts remain; only five text nodes change to redistribute information. Meeting rooms are booked separately in both. Image, crop, phone, typography, sizes, positions, button, colors and lighting are identical. Fictional static mockup.
